'''Operation Silent Roar''' was the codename for a battle during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which occurred above the planet of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. A group of undercover [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agents had secured top secret Republic defense plans and was attempting to flee back to [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] in a stolen [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. They were however, caught by a pursuing Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in a tractor beam over Jabiim. The Imperial [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and a small Imperial fleet were assigned to escort the Imperial agents to safety, protecting them from the pursuing enemy fleet. A space battle eventually ensued with the republic fleet suffering many losses in starfighters and damage to their capital ships. The imperial fleet refrained from engaging the enemy directly, merely keeping them at a distance and giving time for the Imperial Agents' shuttle to reach the safety of the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class']] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="Jabiim Escort" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Silent Roar appears as one of the Space Missions available in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Imperial players are called in to protect a shuttle from many Republic starfighters. As bonus missions the player must destroy 25 Republic fighters and 20 turrets of the Republic vessels.<ref name="Jabiim Escort" />
